coordinate_system.x_positive: east, right when facing into campus from Nguyen Trai

important: Relative arrangement follows docs/map/ussh.png, docs/map/hus.png and docs/map/hus_directory.png. HUS footprints are scaled uniformly from the directory sheet (0.16 game units per px of the 2000 px copy), so they are still estimates, not a survey. Floor counts and which offices sit on which floor come from the HUS directory board the user sent; the order of rooms along a floor is generated, not read from a plan. USSH buildings are closed blocks with no interior. The 18-unit walkway from the HUS gate through T1 and T2 to the lawn is a design choice for play, wider than the real passages.

railway.note: Stylized metro corridor between Nguyen Trai and the campus frontage, estimated from the user satellite screenshot. Deck height lets the demo walk underneath. Not a measured clearance.

interior.note: Game units. Rooms are generated along each corridor; numbers = floor*100 + order along the floor.
interior.wc_note: WC points sit on the WC icons of docs/map/hus_directory.png (same 0.16 units/px transform). The map shows the ground floor; the same WC is repeated on every floor, which is an assumption.

logo.basis: User request: HUS logo centred on T5, facing the court (west face), around floors 5-6, enlarged a little. Logo file supplied by the user (assets/logo/hus_logo.svg); loaded by the web app, not baked into the GLB. Rescaled 2026-10-30: centre at y 20 = the floor 5/6 line with 4.0-unit floors, 11.2 tall.

lamps.note: Lamp posts are decoration for the night view. Positions are design choices.

world_scale.note: 2026-10-30: whole layout scaled 1.3× in X/Z so buildings, corridors and rooms are less cramped; floor height 4.0 = 2.3× the 1.71-unit player. Still game units, not meters.

boundary.note: Outer faces of the perimeter wall. About 15 game units of ground past the yards, Nhà Chuyên đề and the outer edge of Nguyễn Trãi; the old apron (north to -338, south to 130, sides to ±273) was empty. Ground matches this rectangle. Road, sidewalk and the railway deck stop a few units inside the wall.
